id: title:ReeceJones:enforce minimum tls version for managed proxies

review.posthog_relevance: Cloudflare proxy configuration for TLS 1.2 enforcement, potentially improving connection security for PostHog users relying on the Cloudflare edge.
review.reason: The P1 hunks introduce Cloudflare-specific settings to enforce TLS 1.2 and update the API call settings. P1.F1.H1 adds the TLS version constant, while P1.F1.H2 adds the settings payload. P3 hunks are excluded as they are snapshot-only and lack implementation. This represents a substantive, bounded configuration change rather than a narrow maintenance or test-only update.
review.uncertainty: The actual enforcement and compatibility with Cloudflare's behavior are not demonstrated in the code or tests; the benefit relies on the configuration being accepted and effective, which is not verified. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 2 implementation-dependent correctness is established.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two unrelated, unrelated-looking groups of hunks. P1.* hunks are a Cloudflare TLS enforcement change. P3.* hunks are a ClickHouse query rewrite. No shared context or dependency is established between them. P3.* hunks also include snapshot-only changes without the corresponding query implementation, making it impossible to distinguish whether this is a query-plan

observations.behavior: Adds TLS 1.2 minimum and Cloudflare-specific settings; P1.F1.H1 adds CLOUDFLARE_MIN_TLS_VERSION, P1.F1.H2 adds settings to Cloudflare API call. P1.F2.* adds unit tests for the new TLS enforcement.
observations.posthog_connection: Cloudflare proxy service now explicitly requests TLS 1.2, potentially mitigating older TLS versions on the Cloudflare edge. This could help PostHog users relying on secure connections, though the change is not shown to be enforced or tested against actual Cloudflare behavior.
